q-128050.name: Question 1
q-128050.worked_solution:
Dividing a positive number by a negative number gives a negative number. Hence, the result will be negative.

Therefore, since 

$$
8.4÷2.1=4,
$$

we obtain

$$
8.4÷(-2.1)=-4.
$$

q-178615.name: Question 4
q-178615.problem: Expressed as a fraction in its simplest form, $\frac{3}{4}÷(-15)=${{field-1}}.
q-178615.worked_solution:
Dividing a positive number by a negative number gives a negative number. Hence, the result will be negative.

Therefore, since 

$$
\frac{3}{4}÷15=\frac{3}{4\times 15}=\frac{3}{60}=\frac{1}{20},
$$

we obtain

$$
\frac{3}{4}÷(-15)=-\frac{1}{20}.
$$

q-128058.name: Question 6
q-128058.worked_solution:
Dividing a positive number by a negative number gives a negative number. Hence, the result will be negative.

Therefore, since 

$$
\frac{2}{7}÷\frac{5}{14}=\frac{2\times 14}{7\times 5}=\frac{28}{35}=\frac{4}{5},
$$

we obtain

$$
\frac{2}{7}÷(-\frac{5}{14})=-\frac{4}{5}.

Determine the value of 27÷(−514).

a
25
b
−57
c
−25
d
45
e
−45
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Dividing a positive number by a negative number gives a negative number. Hence, the result will be negative.

Therefore, since 27÷514=2×147×5=2835=45, we obtain 27÷(−514)=−45.

q-178619.name: Question 7
q-178619.problem: Expressed as a fraction in its simplest form, $\frac{5}{8}÷(-\frac{3}{4})=${{field-1}}.
q-178619.worked_solution:
Dividing a positive number by a negative number gives a negative number. Hence, the result will be negative.

Therefore, since

$$
\frac{5}{8}÷\frac{3}{4}=\frac{5\times 4}{8\times 3}=\frac{20}{24}=\frac{5}{6},
$$

we obtain

$$
\frac{5}{6}÷(-\frac{3}{4})=-\frac{5}{6}.
$$
